answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three NLP applications and five languages, including (1) Machine Translation (MT) on English-German, German-English, English-French, French-English, and Chinese-English; (2) Language Modeling (LM) on English; and (3) Part-of-Speech (POS) Tagging on English.
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences, language model predictions, POS tags

answer_2.quote: We compute the BLEU score using sacrebleu... Adding Metaphone significantly reduces PPL of the baseline system... The baseline is a Keras implementation of Bi-LSTM POS Tagger... We report accuracy and error rate.
